comment: The GSA Android client is built into Defender. Value 3 enables it by default and removes the
user's ability to disable it. The profile applies only to Android Device Owner enrollment.
Graph requires payloadJson to be base64-encoded JSON, not a raw JSON string (this was the
cause of a generic 400 'An error has occurred' on every apply attempt). The decoded value is:
name: android-defender-gsa-child

payload.description: Managed by sf-intune-cac. Do not edit in the portal.
